hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in frontend/*.ts|frontend/*.tsx) NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v npx >/dev/null || exit 0; cd frontend || exit 0; out=$(npx eslint --fix "${f#frontend/}" 2>&1); status=$?; if [ "$status" -gt 1 ]; then echo "WARN (eslint-autofix): eslint failed to run (exit=$status) on $f -- file NOT auto-fixed, lint manually:" >&2; echo "$out" | tail -20 >&2; fi ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in backend/*.py) command -v uv >/dev/null && cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix "${f#backend/}" 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff format "${f#backend/}" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in app/*.dart) cd app && FL="flutter" DA="dart"; command -v fvm >/dev/null && FL="fvm flutter" DA="fvm dart"; { $DA format "${f#app/}" 2>/dev/null || true; } && { $FL analyze 2>/dev/null || true; } ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py|*.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.dart) grep -nEi '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|tf_[a-zA-Z0-9_]{20,}|BEGIN RSA PRIVATE|BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE)' "$f" && echo 'WARNING: possible secret in file — remove before committing.' || true ;; esac
